`MortSubtableConverter` confines decoding to the bytes of each subtable. For contextual substitutions, `_readClassicSubstitutions` limits glyph indices to less than `size // 2 - offset`, so every replacement word ends at or before the state-table data’s end, even when its size is odd; `_readClassicArray` also checks the read against the bounded reader.
